description: Edit a pull request's title, body, base branch and/or draft state. Title / body / base: the PR's author or anyone with write access; draft: the same rule as gluecron_set_pr_draft (write access and the PR author or repo owner; marking ready starts the AI review). Needs 'repo' scope. Changing the base (open PRs only) re-runs the PR's pull_request CI against the new base and disarms auto-merge. Returns {number, title, body, baseBranch, headBranch, isDraft, changed, autoMergeDisarmed, url}.

body.description: New body (Markdown); an empty string clears it

draft.description: true = back to draft, false = ready for review (gluecron_set_pr_draft's rule: write access and the PR author or repo owner)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_update_pr
